extraction_notes: The forward, reverse, junction-capacitance, and power-derating points are digitized from real plotted traces on p. 2; they are not interpolated table values.
Forward and reverse plots use positive magnitude conventions for forward/reverse voltage and current; the test-condition text preserves the corresponding forward-bias or reverse-bias polarity.
Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 contain separate typical curves for Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC. Fig. 3 is typical at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz.

The p. 2 electrical-characteristics table gives maximum bounds, not typical values. The p. 1 breakdown entry is included because breakdown voltage is explicitly stated at IR = 100 μA; no breakdown behavior was inferred from VRRM.
The p. 2 reverse leakage table also specifies a 25 V maximum of 25 nA; the schema's single reverse_current field records the 75 V maximum of 2.5 μA, while both plotted reverse curves are retained.
